qualitative_notes.text: For USGS 01646500, the dated entries at /timeSeries/values/0/value give 9,980 ft³/s on April 1, 2023, 9,230 ft³/s on April 2, and 8,630 ft³/s on April 3. Subtracting each preceding daily mean gives 9,230 − 9,980 = −750 ft³/s and 8,630 − 9,230 = −600 ft³/s.

The signed endpoint change is 8,630 − 9,980 = −1,350 ft³/s, which also equals the sum of the two daily changes. Using April 1 as the denominator, the percentage drop is (9,980 − 8,630) ÷ 9,980 × 100 = 13.53% (rounded).
